issues: No ТР ТС section headings present in this document (accreditation scope for lab equipment/environmental measurements, not a TR TS product-standards table), so tr_section is null on every row. Columns 4 (ОКПД2) and 5 (ТН ВЭД ЕАЭС) are blank (not dashed) for row 4 (Микроклимат group) in the source table due to merged cell formatting; treated as null. Some indicators (e.g. Оксид углерода, Оксид азота, Диоксид азота, Ангидрид сернистый in row 1) list two parallel ranges (мг/м3 and ppm) for the same indicator; each was split into its own JSON row as instructed.
